8    樂普心泰醫療科技（上海）股份有限公司




     Definitions
     釋義




    "TAVR"                                          transcatheter aortic valve replacement, a catheter-based technique
                                                    to implant a new aortic valve in a minimally invasive procedure
                                                    that does not involve open-chest surgery to correct severe aortic
                                                    stenosis
    「經導管主動脈瓣置換術」                              指     經導管主動脈瓣置換術，一種基於導管的技術，通過不涉及開胸手術
                                                    的微創手術植入新的主動脈瓣，以矯正嚴重的主動脈瓣狹窄

    “TMVCRS”                                        transapical mitral valve repair system (chordal), a catheter-based
                                                    system with two configurations, one enabling artificial mitral chordae
                                                    implantation and the other enabling edge-to-edge chordae repair
    「TMVCRS」                                  指     經心尖二尖瓣修復系統（腱索），一種基於導管且具備兩種裝置的系

    “US$” or “USD”                                  United States dollars, the lawful currency of the United States of

    「美元」                                      指     美國法定貨幣美元

    “Vivo Capital Fund IX”                          Vivo Capital Fund IX, L.P., a limited partnership established under

    「Vivo Capital Fund IX」                    指     Vivo Capital Fund IX, L.P.，一家於2018年3月12日根據美國特拉華州
                                                    法律成立的有限合夥企業及首次公開發售前投資者

    “VSD”                                           ventricular septal defect, a defect, or a hole, in the septum
                                                    between the left and right ventricles of the heart, which may lead to
                                                    abnormal blood circulation and pulmonary hypertension and other

    「室間隔缺損」                                   指     室間隔缺損，心臟左右心室的隔膜的缺損或孔洞，嚴重者可能導致血

     measured at fair value through profit or loss and cash and             金融資產以及現金及現金等價物以外幣計
     cash equivalents are denominated in foreign currencies. We             值，因而使我們面臨外匯風險。我們將通

                                   Case: The Bio-Lefort® Biodegradable left atrial appendage occluder
                                                      was successfully implanted
                                         案例：Bio-Lefort® 生物可降解左心耳封堵器植入術成功完成


                            On February 1, 2023, Bio-Lefort® Biodegradable LAA closure occluder independently
                            developed by the Company was successfully implanted into human body in Hefei Gaoxin
                            Cardiovascular Hospital, which officially opened the curtain of its clinical trial and also
                            marked a new era in the development of global LAA occluder interventional devices. The
                            Bio-Lefort® Biodegradable LAA closure occluder is an innovative medical device that
                            moves from metallic material to biodegradable materials, which promises to effective
                            minimizes potential compression and wear on surrounding tissues, achieve more
                            effective occlusions, and avoid long-term complications and safety risks associated with
                            metal retention.
                            2023年2月1日，心泰醫療自主研發的Bio-Lefort ® 生物可降解左心耳封堵器於合肥高新心血
                            管病醫院順利植入人體，正式拉開了其臨床試驗的帷幕，也標誌着全球左心耳封堵介入器
                            械發展進入新紀元。Bio-Lefort ® 生物可降解左心耳封堵器作為一款實現了從金屬材料向可
                            降解材質升級換代的創新性醫療器械，有望有效減少對周邊組織的磨損，實現更有效的封
                            堵和避免金屬留存體內帶來的長期併發症和安全隱患。

                                          Case: Concerted efforts to combat the pandemic and
                                            demonstrate our corporate social responsibility
                                                   案例：同心抗疫，彰顯企業社會擔當


                     In 2022, the Company actively heeded the country’s call by staying on the front line to ensure
                     supply and production, and donating money and materials to aid in the prevention and control
                     of the pandemic, which demonstrated our fulfillment of social responsibilities as a corporate.
                     In April 2022, the Company donated shelter-based laboratories and equipment to Minhang
                     District, and set up an anti-pandemic material logistics group as soon as being tasked with
                     providing antigen reagents for the whole district. The group set off from Beijing warehouse
                     overnight and transported over 9.5 million antigen reagents to Shanghai. In May 2022, we
                     donated antigen reagents for 1,000 persons and safeguard supplies for Shanghai Lingang
                     Songjiang Science and Technology City.
                     2022 年，公司切實履行企業社會責任，積極響應國家號召，堅守一線保供保產，主動捐款捐
                     物，助力疫情防控工作。2022年4月，公司為閔行區捐贈方艙實驗室及設備。同時，公司在接到
                     保障全區抗原試劑供應任務後，第一時間組建抗疫物資保障組，連夜從北京倉庫出發，運送950
                     餘萬份抗原試劑至上海。2022年5月，我們為上海臨港松江科技城贈送了1,000人份的抗原試劑
                     和保障物資。

     We are deeply aware of the impact of climate change                 我們深刻認識到氣候變化對企
     on the enterprise value chain, which may affect the                 業價值鏈帶來的影響，進而可
     further development of the Company’s business.                      能影響公司業務進一步發展。
     We involve climate change into the risk identification              我們將氣候變化納入風險識別
     process. The following is climate change-related                    過程，以下為我們識別出可能
     risks and opportunities identified by us that may                   影響公司業務運營的氣候變化
     affect the Company’s business operations.                           相關風險及機遇。

     Risks and opportunities        Description
     風險及機遇                          具體描述

     Climate change-related         The capital market is increasingly concerned about the proportion
     opportunities                  of listed companies’ use of clean energy, taking the initiative to
     氣候變化相關機遇                       invest in and use clean energy may help enterprises establish a

                                    注。

     Climate-change related         Climate change may cause sea level rise and intensify the frequency
     risks                          of extreme weather. It will also adversely affect the operation and
     氣候變化相關風險                       production of companies and their employees, which may cause

                                    Climate change may cause a heavy load on the power grid, leading
                                    to an increase in the frequency of power outages, which may

                                    increase operating costs of the Company.

                                  人應解釋不同之處及變動原因。

      POLICY ON DIRECTOR NOMINATION                                       董事提名政策

      The Nomination Committee assesses the candidate or                  提名委員會按誠信、經驗、技能以及為履
      incumbent based on criteria such as integrity, experience, skill    行職責所付出之時間及努力等標準評估候
      and ability to commit time and effort to carry out the duties       選人或在任人。提名委員會之建議將於其
      and responsibilities. The recommendations of the Nomination         後提交董事會以作決定。
      Committee will then be put to the Board for decision.

      According to the nomination policy, the Directors are selected      根據提名政策，董事選任程序如下：
      as per the following procedures:

            the existing Directors, fully communicate with relevant            與本公司相關部門進行充分交流，
            departments of the Company, study the Company’s                    研究本公司對新董事的需求情況；
            demand for new Directors;

      2.    extensively search for candidates for Directors within        2.   根據職位需求及董事會成員多元化
            the Company and its subsidiaries and in the job market             政策，通過本公司、附屬公司內部
            according to the position demand and the board diversity           以及人才市場等多種渠道廣泛搜尋
            policy of the Company;                                             董事人選；

      3.    gather information of each preliminary candidate, including   3.   收集初選人員的職業、學歷、職
            his/her occupation, education, professional title, detailed        稱、詳細工作經歷、全部兼職等情
            work experience and all part-time work record, and                 況，並形成書面材料；
            prepare relevant written materials;

      4.    seek the consent of candidates nominated for Directors        4.   根據相關法律法規和《公司章程》的
            by relevant departments or personnel for their nomination          規定，就相關機構或人員對董事的
            in accordance with relevant laws and regulations and the           提名，徵求候選人對提名的同意，
            Articles of Association, otherwise they may not be the             否則不能將其作為董事人選；
            candidates for Directors;

      5.    convene a Nomination Committee meeting to review              5.   召開提名委員會會議，根據董事的
            the qualifications of the candidates according to the job          任職條件，對候選人進行資格審查；
            requirements for Directors;

            decisions or feedback of the Board.                                他後續工作。

            2.22 Provisions                                                     2.22 撥備

                  Provisions are recognised when the Group has a                   倘本集團因已發生的事件而產
                  present legal or constructive obligation as a result             生現有的法律或推定責任，而
                  of past events, it is probable that an outflow of                履行責任或須耗用資源，且金

                  the amount can be reliably estimated. Provisions are             備。但不會就未來經營虧損確
                  not recognised for future operating losses.                      認撥備。

                  Where there are a number of similar obligations,                 倘出現多項類似責任，則履行
                  the likelihood that an outflow will be required in               責任時導致資源流出的可能性

                  of obligations as a whole. A provision is recognised             即使與同一責任類別中任何一
                  even if the likelihood of an outflow with respect                個項目相關的耗用資源可能性
                  to any one item included in the same class of                    較低，仍須確認撥備。
                  obligations may be small.

                  Provisions are measured at the present value of                  撥備按照於報告期末管理層對
                  management’s best estimate of the expenditure                    履行該現時責任所需支出的最
                  required to settle the present obligation at the end             佳估計的現值計量。用於釐定
                  of the reporting period. The discount rate used to               現值的折現率為反映當前市場
                  determine the present value is a pre-tax rate that               對貨幣時間值及負債特定風險
                  reflects current market assessments of the time                  的評估的稅前利率。隨時間推
                  value of money and the risks specific to the liability.          移產生的撥備增加會被確認為
                  The increase in the provision due to the passage of              利息開支。
                  time is recognised as interest expense.

   Parties are considered to be related if one party has the       如一方能夠直接或間接控制另一方
   ability, directly or indirectly, to control the other party     或在另一方作出財務及經營決策時
   or exercise significant influence over the other party in       施加重大影響，則各方被視為相關
   making financial and operation decisions. Parties are also      聯。受到共同控制的各方亦被視為
   considered to be related if they are subject to common          相關聯。
   control.
